synopsis: Growing up in the same apartment complex, Yuuki and Natsuha have known each other forever. They’ve been friends for so long that everyone just assumes they’re a couple! But as they both approach the final stretch of high school, they get a silly, totally-not-serious idea— what if they actually started dating? What a ridiculous thing to say! Unless…?

title: Mitame Jiraikei Osananajimi no Ren'ai Story
titleJapanese: 見た目地雷系幼馴染の恋愛ストーリー
synopsis:
This is my love story with a landmine girl who's convinced that I'm her childhood friend.
___
**Alt Official Raw:** [X](https://x.com/onnoveltet/status/1829430063294738758)

**Buy:** [Melonbooks](https://www.melonbooks.co.jp/detail/detail.php?product_id=2704719)

title: "Hitokiri" Shoujo Koushaku Reijou no Goei ni Naru
titleJapanese: 『人斬り』少女、公爵令嬢の護衛になる THE COMIC
synopsis:
Shurine, a girl raised for the sole purpose of becoming a bodyguard, is framed by the state and branded a "hitokiri."

Following a life on the run, she meets Lutecia, a duke's daughter, aboard a magical train. With Lutecia's life in danger, Shurine offers a solution:

"If you need a bodyguard, why not hire me right now?"

title: Danshi Kinsei Game Sekai de Ore ga Yaru Beki Yuiitsu no Koto - Yuri no Aida ni Hasamaru Otoko Toshite Tensei Shite Shimaimashita
titleJapanese: 男子禁制ゲーム世界で俺がやるべき唯一のこと　百合の間に挟まる男として転生してしまいました
synopsis:
"Everything for the Score"—nicknamed "Esco"—is a renowned masterpiece in the world of yuri games. A boy who reincarnates into its world suddenly finds himself in the role of Sanjo Hiro, infamously known as "the guy who gets in the way of yuri."

Hiro is a nuisance character who ends up ruined no matter which route he's in. To avoid triggering his death flags, he begins to train and search for a safe path—but for some reason, heroine events keep unfolding around him as the central figure...!?…

title: Tsukushitagari na Uchi no Yome ni Tsuite Derete mo Ii ka
titleJapanese: 尽くしたがりなうちの嫁についてデレてもいいか？
synopsis: There's the flower of Takamine High, Hanae Riko, whom every boy admires. Then, there's the plain boy, Niiyama Minato, who got proposed to by that most beautiful girl in school. Without knowing what's happening, the curtain on their newlywed life rises! For some reason, my bride, who's too cute and happily follows me around everywhere, refuses to leave my side...

title: Madougushi Dahliya wa Utsumukanai: Kyou Kara Jiyuu na Shokunin Life
titleJapanese: 魔導具師ダリヤはうつむかない　～今日から自由な職人ライフ～
synopsis:
A reincarnator, Dahliya, taking advantage of her broken engagement, "I won't hang my head any longer" made firm her resolve.  
  
Now using her beloved magic devices any way she wishes, the fun times keep rolling in――?!

title: Monster Girl Doctor
titleJapanese: モンスター娘のお医者さん
synopsis:
In the town of Lindworm where monsters and humans coexist, Dr. Glenn runs an exemplary medical clinic for monster girls with his lamia assistant, Sapphee. Whether receiving a marriage proposal by a centaur injured in battle, palpating the injury of a mermaid, or suturing the delicate wounds of a flesh golem, Dr. Glenn performs his job with grace and confidence. But when an unsavory character seeks to steal a harpy egg, how will the unflappable Dr. Glenn respond…?
___
**Character Designer:**…

title: Kakenai node Yattemita
titleJapanese: 描けないのでヤってみた
synopsis:
Would you like to do some lewd research with an otaku girl?

Awagi Hajime, an incredibly ordinary otaku college student, decides to make a doujinshi together with his otaku friend, Kujou Rei. The two aim to make a fortune with electronic doujinshi by drawing the ultimate erotic manga, but Kujou is terrible at drawing erotic scenes!! To break through this situation, Kujou and Awaza decide to replicate erotic scenes and use them as reference material.

However, since the two of them are a virgin…

title: Game Sekai no Mob Akuyaku ni Tensei shita node Last Boss wo Mezashitemita ~Nazeka Rekidai Saikou no Meikun to Agamerareteirun desu ga, Dareka Riyuu wo Oshiete Kudasai!~
titleJapanese: ゲーム世界のモブ悪役に転生したのでラスボスを目指してみた～なぜか歴代最高の名君と崇められているんですが、誰か理由を教えてください！～
synopsis:
The last boss of the game Altena Fantasia...

...Isn't me. I was reincarnated as one of his underling mob villains. Determined to take the place of the infamous last boss, I resolved to liven up the game as a true villain. But for some reason, all my misdeeds end up being praised, and my reputation soars...?! How did it come to this? Somebody, please tell me!

title: Multiverse no Watashi, Koishite Ii desu ka? (Pre-Serialization)
titleJapanese: マルチバースの私、恋していいですか?
synopsis:
If things had gone differently, we might never have met, you and I.

Would you have any regrets if you never said "I love you"?

Exploring endless possibilities in this multiverse rom-com one-shot!

title: Akumade Amai Watashi no Kanojo
titleJapanese: あくまであまい私の彼女
synopsis:
Mai Amai, a girl who loves sweets, got dumped by her girlfriend, and she's still grappling with the heartbreak. One day, the café she works at gets a new employee: The gorgeous Lily Kurosaki. Mai falls head over heels for her before realizing Lily is actually a succubus!

"I want to eat you and your parfaits right up! <3"

title: Dekoboko Majo no Oyako Jijou
titleJapanese: でこぼこ魔女の親子事情
synopsis:
One day Alyssa, a witch living alone in the forest, finds a human baby. Although she is confused by the event, 
she decides to raise the baby and names her Viola. 16 years later, Viola has grown far beyond Alyssa's imagination... even too far! 
A heartwarming magical comedy about a mother and a daughter whose appearances are reversed!

title: It Shows on Your Face, Ichijou-San
titleJapanese: 一条さんは顔に出やすい
synopsis:
Mahiro seems to admire Ichijou-san from afar. She's the most popular student in the class and belongs to a very prestigious family. Despite all this, Ichijou-san treats everybody nicely and is equally kind to everyone. But she harbors a secret that Mahiro unexpectedly discovered— she's a vampire! She claims she's not interested in human blood, though there appear to be moments when she's barely able to conceal her innermost desires...
A bloodsucking, heart-throbbing love-comedy about a young…

title: Takane no Hana wa Midaresaki
titleJapanese: 高嶺の華は乱れ咲き
synopsis: She is the perfect student, beautiful, clever and with lots of friends... He is an ordinary boy in the class, staring at her from afar but one day he sees her in a very compromising situation! How will she react? The lives of these two will now intermingle with totally unexpected outcomes!

title: Namae no nai Kaibutsu - Kumo to Shoujo to Ryoki Satsujin
titleJapanese: 名前のない怪物 蜘蛛と少女と猟奇殺人
synopsis: Midnight. Awakened by the echoing sound in my room, I was met with a frightening pair of "legs." Since then, as if wishing to merely make its presence known, it remained in my room without letting itself be seen. In the same way it was spreading its encircling net, little by little it encroached on my life until at last it appeared before me. Its true form was that of an exceedingly beautiful "nameless monster." Desperate resistance was futile as the monster dropped its hand towards me. I could…

title: Mission: Yozakura Family
titleJapanese: 夜桜さんちの大作戦
synopsis:
Taiyo Asano is a super shy high school student and the only person he can talk to is his childhood friend, Mutsumi Yozakura. It turns out that Mutsumi is the daughter of the ultimate spy family! Even worse, Mutsumi is being harassed by her overprotective, nightmare of a brother, Kyoichiro. What drastic steps will Taiyo have to take to save Mutsumi?!
___
Official Release:
- Indonesian release by Elex Media as **Mission: Yozakura Family** (2023)
- [English volumes (Viz…

title: Osananajimi BIGLOVE
titleJapanese: 天使だった幼なじみ、再会したらギャルだった
synopsis:
I once had a childhood friend who was an angel. However, when we met again, several years later, she had become a gyaru. 

A yuri story between two childhood friends.

title: Koutsugou Semi-Friend
titleJapanese: 好都合セミフレンド
synopsis: Kuruma Suuna, a gloomy and socially awkward girl, begins her high school dorm life only to discover her new roommate, Hamanasu Ruka, flirting with another girl!

title: Tower Dungeon
titleJapanese: タワーダンジョン
synopsis:
The setting is a certain kingdom. In order to save the kidnapped princess of the kingdom, the Kingsguard squadron challenges the "Dragon Tower", a gigantic structure floating in the middle of the sky, but they are blocked by powerful demons. A provocation is made by a neighboring village to replenish the injured personnel, and when a young man is sent to the tower, the wheel of fate begins to turn.
___
**Alt Official Raw:** [Comic DAYS](https://comic-days.com/episode/14079602755364316216)…

title: Chiyo Kuno the Psychic
titleJapanese: 予知能力まんが・九能ちよ
synopsis: The story of Kuno Chiyo, a tsundere with the power to see the future, and her friend Kishida who likes her.

title: Uketsukejou ni Kokuhaku Shitakute Guild ni Kayoitsumetara Eiyuu ni Natteta
titleJapanese: 受付嬢に告白したくてギルドに通いつめたら英雄になってた
synopsis:
**I became the strongest hero by frequenting the guild just to see the receptionist!**

Jade, who aims to become the strongest adventurer, arrives at the guild and falls in love at first sight with the receptionist! Determined to talk to her, he realizes the only way to do so is to complete as many quests as possible.

---
Jade, who was born in the countryside, came to the capital in hopes of becoming an adventurer and fell in love with a guild receptionist at first sight. He continued to go…

title: Shujinkou Janai!
titleJapanese: 主人公じゃない！
synopsis:
"Reincarnated as a sub-character of a video game that I used to play!?"  
  
After saving a girl and then getting run over by a car in the process, and "I" was reincarnated as "Rex" in a video game world. A handsome Rex with skills in all fields, but he is a helper character in the early stages. Though Rex has a high level, balanced skill set and multitude of abilities… He's useless in the later stages of the game!!  
  
I decided in the face the fact that I'm useless in this fantasy world…

title: Kamigami ni Sodaterareshi Mono, Saikyou to Naru
titleJapanese: 神々に育てられしもの、最強となる
synopsis:
Will, a baby had nothing with him that shows his identity, was brought to Table Mountain by the God of Thousand Theophanies. He was brought up by the God of Sword, Healing, and Magic to become a brave, strong, and kind boy. When he turned fourteen, a beautiful priestess, Lunamaria, visits the mountain and says that Will is destined to be a Hero. To save the world, Will needs to go on a journey with her.

Is he really the savior of the world? Would he be able to find where he came from? Thus,…

title: Dame Skill [Auto Mode] ga Kakusei Shimashita: Are, Guild no Scout no Minasan, Ore wo "Iranai" tte Ittemasen deshita?
titleJapanese: ダメスキル【自動機能〈オートモード〉】が覚醒しました　～あれ、ギルドのスカウトの皆さん、俺を「いらない」って言ってませんでした？～
synopsis:
Young boy Claus was gifted with a Skill called [Auto Mode]. It is an extremely rare skill and he was so pleased when first received it... Turns out, the skill's abilities [Auto Return] for "only to go home" and [Auto Travel] for "only to go to places that have been visited" are a completely useless ability for both combat and making money! However, the now leveled up Claus has come to know the true nature of [Auto Mode]!
___

title: Otome Kaijuu Caraméliser
titleJapanese: 乙女怪獣キャラメリゼ
synopsis: Afflicted by a "mysterious illness," high school first year Kuroe has spent her entire life avoiding socializing with others. However, after coming into contact with Minami Arata, the most popular boy in school, something changes— and Kuroe's true powers are unleashed…

title: CMYK - Sameda Kazuou wa Chuunibyou ga Naosenai
titleJapanese: CMYK　鮫田和王は厨二病が治せない
synopsis: Sameda Kazuou who has finally escaped from his Chuunibyou syndrome, wants to erase the fact that he was like that at all, and decides to bury all of his school photos that are engraved with his past. However, there are three beautiful girls in the school who want those photos...

title: #Gyaru to Gyaru no Yuri
titleJapanese: ＃ギャルとギャルの百合
synopsis: When flashy high school gals Yua and Reina casually decide—on a whim—to date each other for a year, their spontaneous choice kicks off a wild and heart-thumping ride of laughs, love, and gyaru energy!

title: Isekai Omotenashi Gohan
titleJapanese: 異世界おもてなしご飯
synopsis: Akane, an ordinary office lady, gets summoned to a different world along with her younger sister and pet dog. There, she ends up treating rare guests one after another with hospitality through meals!! Can she satisfy the denizens of a different world with home cooking...?!

title: Ihoujin, Dungeon ni Moguru
titleJapanese: Ihoujin, Dungeon ni Kuguru.
synopsis: Souya, desperate for cash to pay his little sister’s medical expenses, has an offer from a shady company fall into his lap—more than enough money for only a year of work…on the other side of a portal to another dimension, where he’ll have to ascend to the fifty-sixth floor of a dungeon! Worse, his gig-work stint as a fantasy world adventurer gets off on the wrong foot when the transfer process malfunctions, stranding him without supplies! Will his otherworld adventure end before it even begins…?

title: Home Center-goto Yobidasareta Watashi no Daimeikyuu Renovation!
titleJapanese: ホームセンターごと呼び出された私の大迷宮リノベーション！
synopsis: One day, while Saeki Maho visits her favorite hangout spot, her local home center, a sudden Earthquake knocks her unconscious. When she awakens, she discovers she and the entire home center have been transported to another world at the bottom of Melquodia Dungeon, home to the fiercest monsters imaginable. Joined by a misfortunate adventurer named Fiona, Maho needs to find a way out of this dungeon, but luckily, she has everything she could need in one convenient place...

title: Arafoo Otoko no Isekai Tsuhan Seikatsu
titleJapanese: アラフォー男の異世界通販生活
synopsis: Kenichi, a single man in his 40s, is transported into another world for no apparent reason. As he tries to escape a dangerous forest teaming with monsters, he realizes he has the power to access to a huge online store. By using this power to exchange goods he found in this new world for cash, and then buying modern ones off the internet, he was able to quickly create a very popular business. However, his goal is to have a slow and leisurely life.

title: Kuni wo Owareta Ryuushi-san, Hirowareta Ringoku de Ukkari Musou Shite Shimau. ~Jakushou Kokka ga Tairiku Saikyou no Ryuu no Rakuen ni Naru made~
titleJapanese: 国を追われた竜師さん、拾われた隣国でうっかり無双してしまう。～弱小国家が大陸最強の竜の楽園になるまで～
synopsis:
Breed, an old dragon master, is not only fired from his job but also exiled from his country... but the dragons love him and follow him!?
___
**Alt Official Raw:** [MagaPoke](https://pocket.shonenmagazine.com/episode/2550912964695382195)

title: Undead-san no Bukiyou na Seishun
titleJapanese: アンデッドさんの不器用な青春
synopsis: One day after summer break, the perfect young lady, Sana Tsukuyomi, showed up at school as an undead. As a school health committee member, I, Hiyoshi, ended up helping her navigate her daily life, despite her movements being as stiff as a corpse’s… A school romantic comedy featuring a heroine who’s both scary and cute!

title: Majutsushi Kunon wa Miete Iru
titleJapanese: 魔術師クノンは見えている
synopsis: Kunon Gurion, who was born blind, has one goal in life: finding a way to use his magic to see, something no one has ever done before. Luckily, Kunon's talent for magic leads him to quickly surpass his teacher. Before long, his name reaches even the royal palace, earning him the rare opportunity to study under a powerful mentor.

title: Killing Bites
titleJapanese: キリングバイツ
synopsis: People have been created that are human-animal hybrids, and powerful businesses bet on the outcome of their duels. College student Nomoto Yuuya's casual acquaintances ask him to drive them around to pick up girls one day, which he soon finds out means by force. The girl they kidnap is an animal-human hybrid named Hitomi, who slaughters all of them except Yuuya. Hitomi is a honey badger, which has been called the most fearless of all animals. Now Hitomi is assigned to stay with Yuuya, for his…

title: Dòupò Cāngqióng
synopsis: In a land where there is no magic, a land where the strong make the rules and weak have to obey, a land filled with alluring treasures and beauty, yet also filled with unforeseen danger. Xiao Yan, who has shown talents none had seen in decades, suddenly lost everything three years ago - his powers, his reputation, and his promise to his mother. What sorcery has caused him to lose all of his powers? And why has his fiancée suddenly shown up?
